headline: New templates feature streamlines FAQs and content reuse
summary: This new functionality allows users to quickly answer frequently asked questions and store reusable text snippets. It aims to significantly boost efficiency for various communication needs.
details: The new templates feature is designed to enhance user efficiency by enabling quick answers to frequently asked questions. It also provides a convenient method for storing and reusing common text snippets across various communications.

This functionality aims to streamline workflows, significantly reducing the time and effort spent on repetitive typing. It is particularly beneficial for support teams, content creators, and anyone requiring consistent messaging.

headline_marked: [[Developer's Checklist for RAG]] goes beyond chunk-embed-search with 10 lifecycles
headline: Developer's Checklist for RAG goes beyond chunk-embed-search with 10 lifecycles
summary: A new checklist details 10 critical lifecycles for building production-ready RAG systems, moving past the basic 'chunk-embed-search' model. It's essential for developers to know all components.
details: Building production-ready RAG systems involves far more than the common 'chunk → embed → search → LLM' mental model. A new checklist outlines 10 crucial lifecycles developers must consider for robust implementations.
The checklist, originally published on Hashnode, provides a condensed, practical guide to what needs checking. It aims to bridge the gap between simple demos and fully functional RAG systems.

While not every box needs checking on day one for early builders, understanding the existence of each lifecycle is key. Full technical breakdowns with architecture diagrams are available in the complete write-up.
